qe:
Error Spotting: Select the part that contains an error:
'The environment (A) / of the city (B) / is much more (C) / healthier than before (D).'
qh:
त्रुटि पहचानें: उस भाग का चयन करें जिसमें त्रुटि है:
'The environment (A) / of the city (B) / is much more (C) / healthier than before (D).'
e: Rule: Avoid Double Comparatives. 'Healthier' is already a comparative degree, so 'more' is redundant. Use 'much' for emphasis, but not 'more healthier'.

qe: Direct/Indirect: The doctor said to the patient, 'Take these medicines twice a day for a week and come for a follow-up next Monday.'
qh: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन: The doctor said to the patient, 'Take these medicines twice a day for a week and come for a follow-up next Monday.'
o: The doctor advised the patient to take those medicines twice a day for a week and go for a follow-up the following Monday
The doctor told the patient take these medicines
The doctor asked the patient to take those medicines
The doctor advised the patient to take these medicines
e: Rule: 'Advised' is appropriate for doctors. 'These' changes to 'those', 'come' changes to 'go', and 'next Monday' changes to 'the following Monday'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'In spite of the heavy rains, the match ______ to its logical conclusion.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'In spite of the heavy rains, the match ______ to its logical conclusion.'
e: Phrasal Verb: 'Went on' means continued. The match continued despite the weather.

qe: One Word Substitution: 'A small room in a big house, hotel, or ship where glasses, dishes, and food are kept.'
qh: एक शब्द: 'बड़े घर, होटल या जहाज का वह छोटा कमरा जहाँ बर्तन और भोजन रखा जाता है।'
e: Vocabulary: Pantry is the specific word for a room where provisions and kitchenware are stored.

qe: Sentence Improvement: 'If I had realized that the road was so slippery, I would not have driven so fast.'
qh: वाक्य सुधार: 'If I had realized that the road was so slippery, I would not have driven so fast.'
e: Rule: This is a Third Conditional sentence (If + had + V3, would have + V3). The sentence is grammatically correct.

qe: Synonym: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: 'EPHEMERAL'
qh: समानार्थी: 'EPHEMERAL' का सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची चुनें।
e: Meaning: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time. Transitory (क्षणभंगुर) is the synonym.

qe: Antonym: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: 'GREGARIOUS'
qh: विलोम: 'GREGARIOUS' का सबसे उपयुक्त विपरीतार्थक चुनें।
e: Meaning: Gregarious means fond of company; sociable. Reserved (अंतर्मुखी) is the opposite.

qe: Idiom: 'To spill the beans.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To spill the beans.'
e: Meaning: To accidentally or prematurely reveal a secret.

qe: Active/Passive: 'The storm has severely damaged the coastal villages.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'The storm has severely damaged the coastal villages.'
o: The coastal villages have been severely damaged by the storm
The coastal villages were severely damaged
The coastal villages are being damaged
The coastal villages had been damaged
e: Rule: Present Perfect (has/have + V3) changes to 'has/have + been + V3'.

qe: Error Spotting: 'The reason (A) / why he failed (B) / was because (C) / he didn't study (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The reason (A) / why he failed (B) / was because (C) / he didn't study (D).'
e: Rule: Avoid redundancy. 'The reason why' should be followed by 'that', not 'because'.

qe: Vocabulary (Spelling): Select the incorrectly spelled word.
qh: वर्तनी: गलत वर्तनी वाले शब्द का चयन करें।
e: Spelling: The correct spelling is Millennium (double 'n').

qe: Fill in the blank: 'The prisoner was ______ for his crimes.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The prisoner was ______ for his crimes.'
e: Verb: For execution (legal death), the past participle is 'hanged'. 'Hung' is used for objects like pictures.

qe: Idiom: 'To drive someone up the wall.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To drive someone up the wall.'
e: Meaning: To make someone extremely irritated or angry.

qe: Error Spotting: 'Either of the (A) / two paths (B) / lead to (C) / the same destination (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'Either of the (A) / two paths (B) / lead to (C) / the same destination (D).'
e: Rule: 'Either of', 'Neither of', 'Each of' always take a singular verb. Correct: 'leads to'.

qe: Active/Passive: 'She is reading a novel.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'She is reading a novel.'
o: A novel is being read by her
A novel was read by her
A novel is read by her
e: Rule: Continuous tense adds 'being'.

qe: Antonym: Antonym of 'EXODUS'.
qh: विलोम: 'EXODUS' का विलोम।
e: Meaning: Exodus means a mass departure. Arrival (आगमन) is the opposite.

qe: One Word: 'A person who is recoverning from an illness.'
qh: एक शब्द: 'वह व्यक्ति जो बीमारी से ठीक हो रहा हो।'
e: Vocabulary: Convalescent is the correct term for recovery phase.

qe: Sentence Improvement: 'I prefer coffee than tea.'
qh: वाक्य सुधार: 'I prefer coffee than tea.'
e: Rule: 'Prefer' is followed by the preposition 'to'.

qe: Direct/Indirect: He said, 'I have been working since morning.'
qh: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन: He said, 'I have been working since morning.'
o: He said that he had been working since morning
He said that he has been working
e: Rule: Present Perfect Continuous changes to Past Perfect Continuous.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'The old man is ______ weak to walk.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The old man is ______ weak to walk.'
e: Rule: 'Too...to' structure indicates inability.

qe: Active/Passive: 'Open the window.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'Open the window.'
e: Rule: Imperative passive: 'Let + obj + be + V3'.

qe: Synonym: Synonym of 'MEAGER'.
qh: समानार्थी: 'MEAGER' का पर्यायवाची।
e: Meaning: Meager means very small amount. Scanty is the synonym.

qe: Error Spotting: 'He was (A) / very tired (B) / so he (C) / laid down (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He was (A) / very tired (B) / so he (C) / laid down (D).'
e: Rule: Confusing verbs. Past of 'Lie' (recline) is 'lay'. 'Laid' is the past of 'Lay' (put something down). Correct: 'lay down'.

qe: Idiom: 'A piece of cake.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'A piece of cake.'
e: Meaning: A task that is very easy to accomplish.

qe: Vocabulary: Correct spelling of 'Jewellery'.
qh: वर्तनी: सही शब्द चुनें।
e: Spelling: Jewellery is the British English standard (Double L).

qe: Antonym: Antonym of 'VIGILANT'.
qh: विलोम: 'VIGILANT' का विलोम।
e: Meaning: Vigilant means alert/watchful. Careless is the opposite.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'She takes pride ______ her beauty.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'She takes pride ______ her beauty.'
e: Preposition: 'Take pride in' is a fixed idiom. (However, 'proud of' is used).

qe: One Word Substitution: 'A handwriting that cannot be read.'
qh: एक शब्द: 'लिखावट जिसे पढ़ा न जा सके।'
e: Vocabulary: Illegible is the term for unreadable writing.

qe: Sentence Improvement: 'No sooner had he arrived when it started raining.'
qh: वाक्य सुधार: 'No sooner had he arrived when it started raining.'
e: Rule: The pair for 'No sooner' is always 'than'.

qe: Error Spotting: 'If I was him (A) / I would not (B) / accept (C) / the gift (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'If I was him (A) / I would not (B) / accept (C) / the gift (D).'
e: Rule: Subjunctive mood for hypothetical cases. Use 'If I were he'.

qe: Direct/Indirect: He said to me, 'What are you doing?'
qh: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन: He said to me, 'What are you doing?'
o: He asked me what I was doing
He asked me what was I doing
He told me what am I doing
e: Rule: Indirect question becomes assertive. 'Are doing' changes to 'was doing'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'He is ______ M.A. in English.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'He is ______ M.A. in English.'
e: Article: 'M.A.' starts with a vowel sound ('Em'), so use 'an'.

qe: Idiom: 'To be under the weather.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To be under the weather.'
e: Meaning: To feel slightly sick or ill.

qe: Active/Passive: 'They have won the match.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'They have won the match.'
o: The match has been won by them
e: Rule: Present Perfect passive: 'has been + V3'.

qe: Synonym: Synonym of 'ABUNDANT'.
qh: समानार्थी: 'ABUNDANT' का पर्यायवाची।
e: Meaning: Abundant means existing in large quantities. Plentiful is the synonym.
